headline: MIN @ HOU matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIN 3.84 at HOU 4.77, with a projected total of 8.60. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward HOU: MIN moved -0.77 runs while HOU moved +0.13, changing the projected margin by -0.89 runs. The projected total fell -0.64, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +17.9%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Joe Ryan has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Isaac Paredes, Trevor Larnach, Jeremy Peña, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Joey Loperfido, Yordan Alvarez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
